backtest_protocol.execution_model: Earnings event confirmation is derived from canonical daily earnings snapshot transitions dated at or before the signal date. OHLCV confirmation is observed through the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.

earnings_snapshots.event_confirmation_rule: DTE reset <=7 to >=20 plus eps_actual_last or latest historical_surprise_pct change.

runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: recently confirmed positive EPS surprise plus retained post-event price/RS strength should identify PEAD-like candidates beyond core entries.

2_history_check.exp-20260426-037: Older post-earnings shadow had zero candidates due sparse DTE0 event coverage.
2_history_check.exp-20260531-003: Pre-earnings imminent surprise/RS improved aggregate but regressed late_strong and drawdown; this run is post-event and requires 3/3 window improvement.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-003: Accepted explicit post-earnings continuation semantics; this run tests a separate candidate source using the same production-visible snapshot lifecycle.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-004: DTE0 reaction scout selected zero trades; this widens to 0-5 trading days after a confirmed positive surprise.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Recently confirmed positive EPS surprise events with retained post-event price/RS strength may add a production-visible default-off candidate pool beyond the accepted core.
interpretation: The post-earnings positive-surprise drift sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry adjacent event-reaction/surprise/RS thresholds on these frozen windows without forward rows or a richer event-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, use closed forward replacement-value rows or a richer production-visible event-quality field such as guidance direction, same-event revenue/EPS mix, or audited filing/news tone.

source_definition: canonical daily earnings snapshot transition shows DTE reset from <=7 to >=20
eps_actual_last or latest historical_surprise_pct changes on the reset date
first qualifying signal within 0-5 trading days after event confirmation
ticker closes above prior 50-day moving average
event-to-signal return and excess return versus SPY are non-negative
same-ticker core overlap is filtered by the shared framework
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted post-earnings continuation semantics improved all windows, but the DTE0 reaction source had zero selected trades. Snapshot transition-derived positive surprises should provide more sample while staying production-visible.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

production_parity.parity_note: No production code path is changed. If promoted later, the source must be moved into a shared default-off adapter using the same daily earnings snapshot lifecycle already documented in docs/production_backtest_parity.md, with focused parity tests before any live/report consumer uses it.
